snippet.title: Living with my Little Sister - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Store: https://saikeystudios.com/product/living-with-my-little-sister/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=post
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3478020/Living_with_my_Little_Sister/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=post

Your truant younger sister decided to crash into your apartment. Improve your relationship by spending time with her while balancing your job as an illustrator. Give her head pat, cook for her, or... do a little prank to her.
